parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate how water cools. The thermometers have been set up in the clamps for you. Do not adjust the heights of the thermometers. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Pour hot water into the beaker until it just covers the bulb of the upper thermometer. Do not stir the water for the rest of the experiment.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Wait for about 30 seconds before taking any measurements.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Start the stopclock and read both thermometers. In the top row of Table 2.1, record these temperatures.

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Record in the table the temperature θ of each thermometer at 1 minute intervals until time t = 6 minutes.

parts.label: v
parts.text: (v) Complete the column headings in the table. Table 2.1 thermometer bulb near the bottom of the beaker thermometer bulb near the surface of the water t / min θ / θ / 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 [4]
